name: How long does it take to sell a home with a cash offer versus listing with an agent?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to sell a home with a cash offer versus listing with an agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selling with a cash offer typically takes as little as 7-30 days to close, as it bypasses the financing and appraisal stages. Listing with an agent usually takes longer, often 30-60 days to secure a buyer, plus another 30-60 days for closing, depending on market conditions and buyer financing. The total timeline can vary significantly based on the specific market dynamics in regions like Palm Beach County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cash offers close quickly, often in weeks; agent listings can take 2-4 months from market entry to closing.
